What We Do

Garage Door Services in Central Florida

Whatever your garage door needs — a quick fix, a worn-out part, or a complete new installation — our local team has it covered. Every job comes with a free estimate and upfront pricing.

🔧 01

Garage Door Repair

A garage door that won't close, hangs crooked, or grinds loudly isn't just annoying — it's a security and safety risk. Our technicians arrive in a fully stocked truck and repair off-track doors, frayed or snapped cables, bent tracks, worn rollers, and damaged panels on the spot. We service every major brand and most doors built in the last 30 years.

Get a Free Estimate
🔩 02

Broken Spring Replacement

Garage door springs carry the entire weight of your door, and Central Florida's heat and humidity wear them out faster than the national average. A snapped spring will leave your door stuck shut (or dangerously heavy). We replace torsion and extension springs with high-cycle, corrosion-resistant springs and always replace them in matched pairs so your door stays balanced for years.

Get a Free Estimate
📱 03

Opener Repair & Installation

From dead motors and stripped gears to finicky remotes and safety-sensor faults, we repair every type of opener. Ready for an upgrade? We install quiet belt-drive and smart Wi-Fi openers with smartphone control and battery backup — so a Florida power outage never traps your car inside.

Get a Free Estimate
🏠 04

New Garage Door Installation

A new garage door is one of the highest-return home upgrades you can make. We install insulated steel, carriage-house, and modern aluminum-and-glass doors — including Florida hurricane-rated, wind-load-certified models that help protect your home and may lower your insurance. Free in-home design consultations and upfront pricing.

Get a Free Estimate
⚙️ 05

Cables, Rollers & Tracks

The small parts do the hard work. Frayed lift cables, cracked nylon rollers, loose hinges, and bent tracks make a door noisy, jerky, and unsafe. We replace these wear items with heavy-duty components and re-balance the door so it glides quietly again.

Get a Free Estimate
✅ 06

Maintenance & Tune-Ups

The cheapest repair is the one you never need. Our 25-point tune-up lubricates and adjusts every moving part, tightens hardware, tests the safety reverse, and re-balances the door. Ideal before hurricane season — and a smart move for any door over a few years old.

Get a Free Estimate

Not sure what's wrong with your door?

That's what we're here for. Call us and describe what's happening — most of the time we can tell you what it likely is and give a ballpark before we ever roll a truck.
